evals.prompt: Create a typed CMS client for a shared operations contract with Payload config types, auth headers, and a timeout plugin.
evals.expected_output: A createCMSClient integration preserving the native SDK and typed operation tree.
expectations: Supplies both Config and typeof operations when explicit Payload typing is used.
Places auth in baseInit and timeout in the public plugin API.
Uses cms.payload and cms.operations without proxies or SDK internals.

evals.prompt: Send a void operation with a caller AbortSignal and a call header that overrides a base header.
evals.expected_output: A bodyless POST that preserves caller cancellation and documented header precedence.
expectations: Leaves method and body under operation control.
Lets the call header override the base header and removes Content-Length.
Does not classify caller abort as timeout.

evals.prompt: Review a plugin that logs request bodies and upgrades any JSON with defined:true into a domain error.
evals.expected_output: Reject credential/body leakage and require complete operation-specific envelope validation.
expectations: Requires code, status, message, and data schema agreement.
Downgrades forged or malformed envelopes to a generic safe error.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why operation timeouts become INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR while Payload SDK timeouts must remain native.
evals.expected_output: Trace timeout normalization through plugin and response body parsing without changing SDK errors.
expectations: Checks request source and timeout signal identity.
Preserves the package timeout across response parsing.

evals.prompt: Add client timeout behavior and server access control to one payload-operations feature.
evals.expected_output: Implement timeout through the client plugin and route access policy to server guidance.
expectations: Keeps timeout out of the contract and handler.
Keeps authorization out of the transport plugin.
Preserves shared operation metadata across both sides.
